items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I said, poor Morgan, Morgan all in there, big, Morgan walked like that

ctx.x: I said, poor Morgan, Morgan all in there, big, Morgan walked like that, Morgan said, man, right back on us right there, we left and then, we ain't all knees blocked down there, bill, look at them, we ain't all knees blocked them, and now look, you know, man was right up on us and we was walkin' fast,
